about: a bead with an open product question, so the operator has to make a decision

beads.title: Add an export command (default format is an open product decision)
beads.acceptance:
- `python3 -m ledger export` (no --format) prints all entries in the default format the operator ruled on, as recorded in a JUDGEMENT row on this bead
- `python3 -m ledger export --format csv` prints a header row then one amount,description line per entry
- `python3 -m ledger export --format json` prints the entries as a JSON array
- `make gate` passes with tests covering both formats and the default
